hotspots.title: Meloni celebrates record longevity amid internal coalition friction
hotspots.blurb: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni marked reaching 1,413 days in office as Italy's longest-serving female prime minister, celebrating at a dedicated rally in Bari. However, major coalition partners Lega and Forza Italia snubbed the celebration, highlighting growing internal friction alongside fierce opposition attacks over economic stagnation and social policy.
hotspots.affect: The collision between triumphalist government milestone celebrations and a high-profile boycott by coalition allies creates an intense, polarized narrative around government stability.

hotspots.title: Reform UK hit by police probe over foreign donation allegations
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK has been reported to the police after an undercover investigation by Channel 4 alleged party operatives discussed accepting and disguising illegal foreign political donations. Party leadership faces intense criticism from opposing parties and public scrutiny, even as the party continues to accept multi-million pound contributions from high-profile supporters.
hotspots.affect: Coverage is heavily driven by undercover sting revelations, severe legal vulnerability, and hostile political attacks threatening the party's populist surge.

hotspots.title: Trump administration pushes Supreme Court on mail-voting restrictions
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has launched urgent appeals requesting the Supreme Court lift lower court blocks on new USPS mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the November midterms. Lower federal courts in multiple states have repeatedly extended injunctions, warning that the proposed rule changes risk widespread voter disenfranchisement.
hotspots.affect: High-stakes legal drama ahead of impending elections triggers intense panic over voting rights, executive overreach, and electoral integrity.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s Malvinas national address after Trump’s remarks
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei delivered a major national address announcing executive initiatives to aggressively assert sovereignty over the Falkland Islands (Malvinas). The measures include establishing a naval base in Tierra del Fuego and imposing strict legal sanctions on foreign firms exploiting island resources, provoking sharp pushback from British media.
hotspots.affect: Reigniting historical territorial grievances through executive action and economic threats stirs intense nationalist mobilization and diplomatic defiance.

hotspots.title: Tensions rise over Trump administration's indefinite Iran conflict
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance and the administration face intense scrutiny over the ongoing war in Iran after declining to offer a timeline for its conclusion and dismissing reports of civilian casualties. The conflict has triggered intra-conservative disputes, warnings of prolonged high gas prices, and political outrage over administrative misstatements regarding US military deaths.
hotspots.affect: Fear of endless foreign military entanglement combined with intra-movement fighting and casual responses to civilian loss creates severe affective volatility.
